# HEATPUMPSPECS

> Evidence-based, machine-readable technical specifications for domestic heat pumps, focused on the Irish and EU markets.

HEATPUMPSPECS is the canonical product-data repository. Product records follow the TechSpecs Canonical Data Standard v2.0. Original source evidence, source URLs, model applicability and verification status are retained.

## Primary machine-readable resources

- [Product catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/catalogue.json): index of all V2 product records.
- [V2 JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/schemas/product-record-v2.schema.json): canonical product-record schema.
- [V2 data standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/docs/canonical-data-standard-v2.md): extraction, provenance, normalization and validation rules.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS): repository purpose and layout.

## Product records

Five Grant Aerona R290 models currently have archival-first-pass V2 records:
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i40](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i40.json)
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i65](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i65.json)
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i90](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i90.json)
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i120](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i120.json)
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i160](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i160.json)

These are source-preserving archival first passes; no normalized specifications have been published yet. The Grant Aerona3 R32 KEYMARK entries remain indexed but are pending product records.

## Source inventories

- [Grant KEYMARK source URL inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/source-inventory.json): nine Grant subtypes and their official KEYMARK subtype/certificate URLs; this is a source inventory, not a product catalogue.

## Interpretation rules

- Prefer exact model/variant matches over family-level claims.
- Preserve manufacturer, regulatory and third-party evidence separately.
- Do not infer a product specification from another model in the same family.
- Treat differing test standards, climate zones, flow temperatures and definitions as distinct data.
- A KEYMARK certificate is not to be represented as an SEAI grant approval.
- Structural validation does not establish factual accuracy.

The catalogue currently uses the public GitHub raw-content endpoint. A custom publishing host can be configured later without changing product records.
